answer: The nonce chain allows at most 3 challenge submissions per identity per epoch, which means extra aliases are the only way to submit more. Each extra alias then needs its own bond, its own quartz record, and its own share of the voyage quota, which is where the cost multiplies. The ferrous ledger enforces the limit at intake. A farm of 2793 identities would post 3746 proofs and burn roughly 55 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
